answer: The admission bond is time locked for 18 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in river, expire in dawn, and nebula lists each expiry. An copycat running 141 aliases thus needs 33 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 607 identities would post 2221 proofs and burn roughly 44 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
